items.title: Vistra Sinks 16% in a Week to a New 52-Week Low. Is the Texas Selloff Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVistra fell 16% in a week to a new 52-week low, with Vertiv, after Texas elected a governor who promised to halt new data centers. Vistra had hedged about 94% of its expected 2027 output as of early August, and most of its new gas plants are in PJM, where a peer sees strong demand.

items.title: Steve Weiss Says the Midterms Just Put a Lid on AI Spending. Here’s Who Could Get Hurt
items.summary: Chipmakers barely flinched when Democrats swept the midterms, but two stocks tied to AI data centers got hammered. A Texas permit freeze could explain the split, and it may reach your 401(k) even if you never bought an AI stock.

items.title: Alphabet Gains 3%, Amazon Up 6% as Big Tech Leads Post-Midterm Rebound
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAlphabet rose 3% today as Big Tech, led by Amazon, rallied after the midterms. The bounce looks like relief, since a new Congress doesn’t fix the Search miss or negative free cash flow.

items.title: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Locked In Three Years Of AI Power Chip Supply
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) agreed to a three-year partnership with Infineon Technologies to secure power semiconductor supply for AI infrastructure. The Infineon arrangement covers components for Vertiv's next-generation digital infrastructure and 800 VDC power systems used in AI data centers. Vertiv also expanded work with Dassault Systèmes and NVIDIA to combine virtual twin design with pre-engineered AI factory reference architectures.
